text:
eli: heads-up — new contributor hit failure running the Ruby sampleapp on Apple Silicon during onboarding. CI shows native gem (ffi) prebuilt not available and local `bundle install` compiles and fails.
kevin: can you paste the error? often `ffi` needs libffi headers or wrong arch binary.
eli: error snippet: ```Gem::Ext::BuildError: ERROR: Failed to build gem native extension.
current directory: /workspace/vendor/bundle/ruby/3.2.0/gems/ffi-1.15.5/ext/ffi_c
clang: error: unknown argument: '-m64'
*** extconf.rb failed ***
```
jen: looks like the extension build used x86 flags on arm64 runner — bundler pulled x86-compiled gem or the build flags are wrong. Which runner image?
eli: GH Actions macos-12-arm64. Contributor using homebrew-installed ruby 3.2 too.
sam: quick workaround: add `arch -arm64 gem install ffi -- --enable-libffi-alloc` or set RUBY_CONFIGURE_OPTS for correct flags. For CI, we should prefer platform-specific prebuilt gems in the bundle cache.
eli: opened tiny PR to update sampleapp CI matrix and add note to onboarding docs about arm64 deps: https://git.example.com/redwood/devex/pulls/342
devex-bot: PR 342 opened by eli in devex  reviewers requested: kevin, jen
kevin: thanks. also flag: while testing I noticed streaming chat in the sampleapp sometimes dies with 401 during a long replay test. Token refresh in rb-sdk isn't recreating the request for streaming flows, so the retry path reuses a stale socket.
jen: that matches an old parity gap. Other SDKs rebuild the HTTP request object and force a new connection when a refresh happens mid-request. We should mirror that behavior in rb-sdk to avoid silent stream failures.
eli: I can add a patch in rb-sdk that forces reconnect on auth refresh for streaming endpoints; will add unit and an integration smoke.
kevin: please guard it so we only force-reconnect when the auth workflow triggers (401->refresh) and not for normal transient errors. Also add a short note in the sampleapp quickstart about how short-lived tokens affect streaming reliability.
eli: PR opened: https://git.example.com/redwood/rb-sdk/pulls/197  includes test harness to simulate 401 then success for stream reconnect
ci-bot: build 7823 failed on mac-arm64  https://ci.example.com/build/7823
eli: pinned the macos runner in the PR and added a fallback step to `gem install ffi` with arch override; CI green on the matrix after caching prebuilt gem for arm64.
kevin: LGTM pending small test tweak. Good catch, thanks for making the sampleapp onboarding smoother.
jen: follow-up: add a 1-line "macOS (Apple Silicon)" quickstart note under prerequisites to reduce friction for new contributors.
eli: filing issue for doc tweak: https://git.example.com/redwood/devex/issues/319
eli: thanks all :shipit:
